info.timeAllocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course is based on the "An Introduction to Programming the Internet of Things (IoT)" Specialization at https://www.coursera.org/specializations/iot.

The course covers embedded systems, the Raspberry Pi Platform and the Arduino environment for building devices that can control the physical world. Unlike traditional computer-based systems, IoT devices are “embedded” within other devices in order to provide enhanced functionality without exposing the user to the complexities of a computer. In terms of programming, Arduino - an open-source computer hardware/software platform for building digital devices and interactive objects, is a great choice for controlling small devices, whereas the Raspberry Pi - a small single-board computer, is useful for designing and developing practical IoT devices.

Students must complete the IOT102 course before participating in this course. Students will start with a detailed introduction to the internet of things and embedded systems, then work with Arduino and program in C, then work with Raspberry Pi and program in Python, and finally produce a group project. In this final project, students will apply the skills learned by designing, building and testing a microcontroller-based embedded system, completing a unique final project that can be listed as an achievement in their CVs.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by the instructor in class or at home and submit everything on time.

- Students should use laptops in class only for learning purpose.

- Students must frequently go to https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

- Labs are done in groups at Lab rooms (2-3 students/group); Final Projects are built and reported at Lab rooms in the same groups of students. Each group works with a standard set of devices** which is used for both labs and Final Project. Students can buy extra devices if wanted.

materials.materialDescription: Introduction to the Internet of Things and Embedded Systems
The Arduino Platform and C Programming
The Raspberry Pi Platform and Python Programming for the Raspberry Pi
Programming for the Internet of Things Project

clos.loDetails: Understand the concept of the Internet of Things and the components of an embedded system
Know how to program and debug in Arduino with C language, and how to use sensors and actuators
Know how to use different types of Arduino-specific shields
Know how to set up and execute basic Python code in the Raspberry Pi environment
Know how to use Python-based IDE, protocols and other external devices on the Raspberry Pi
Know how to design from a basic sensor-actuator system to more sophisticated hardware systems using Raspberry Pi expansion boards
Apply all the skills learned to create a system-level design of a microcontroller-based embedded system, along with a requirements specification document and a test plan
